query:
DELETE FROM late_allow_propagation lap
            WHERE lap.host_chain_id = $1
              AND (
                  (
                      lap.block_number < $2
                      AND EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM computations c
                          WHERE c.output_handle = lap.handle
                      )
                      AND NOT EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM computations c
                          WHERE c.output_handle = lap.handle
                            AND c.is_allowed = false
                      )
                  )
                  OR lap.block_number < $3
              )
